title: Meet Custom Agents in Business Central
summary: Custom agents in Business Central improve efficiency and reduce human error through AI capabilities. The post discusses how developers should position themselves for the future of Business Central and AI integration.
key_points: AI integration reduces human error in processes
Developers need to adapt their skills for AI-driven future
Business Central is moving toward agent-based automation

quotes.text: Efficiency goes up with less human error
quotes.why_it_matters: Demonstrates the core business value of custom agents in reducing operational mistakes
